name: 30606 · Athens, GA
findings: ZIP 30606 (Athens) has 187 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30606 (Athens) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
